options.name: Speed of sound
options.description: Speed of sound in air filling the room.

options.name: Global scattering coefficient
options.description: Broadband scattering coefficient for all surfaces of the room.

options.name: Image sources: Order
options.description: The maximum order of image sources to consider. Higher order reflections will be generated via the ray tracer. A higher number will increase computation time and memory usage.

options.name: Ray tracing: Number of rays
options.description: The number of rays to trace from each source. Higher numbers will yield more accurate results but will take longer to compute.

options.name: Ray tracing: detector radius
options.description: The radius of the detector sphere around each receiver point. Rays that intersect this sphere will be considered as detected by the receiver.

options.name: Ray tracing: Time threshold
options.description: The maximum time for which a ray will be followed.

options.name: Ray tracing: Energy threshold
options.description: The energy threshold below which a ray will no longer be followed.

options.name: Sampling rate
options.description: The sampling rate of the simulated room impulse response.
